About this wiki

This is an independent fan-made character wiki for your original characters. It is a standalone HTML website, so you can open it in a browser and edit it.

The site doesn't publish itself on the internet automatically. To share it publicly, you would need to upload the HTML file and images to a hosting service.

Edit Wiki

Choose a character, change the name or description, and save. You can also add a character with an image from your device. Changes are saved in this browser on this device.
